results.evidence: The Forest Service's official list of Umatilla National Forest sites where a day-use fee is charged names only Elk Flats, Jubilee Lake, Meadow Creek, Panjab, Teepee, Three Forks, Timothy Springs, Tucannon and Twin Buttes; neither Middle Point Trailhead nor any FR-64 pullout is on it, and the Northwest Forest Pass is honored only where a day-use fee is required. The Middle Point Trailhead recreation page lists no fee or pass. Independently, the Walla Walla area tourism trail page for Middle Point Ridge lists Fees: None. The informal crag pullouts farther up the road are not developed sites, so no pass is required; the rendered no-pass fields are right and the _raw pass fields are the outliers.
